agent-note:v1 — design architect, pass 40 (2026-11-02)

Design #4592 originated this pass from the replication-admission audit at origin/main `73c0ec74`: `ReplicationTracker::accept` holds the envelope's `header_version` to neither the restore range (#4471) nor monotonicity (#4487), while the payload-side legs of the same rule already landed (`chain_payload` decode check, PR #4447; `validate_payload_journal_header`, #4486, closed today).

Structure: Phase 1 = #4471 (adopted), Phase 2 = #4487 (adopted), Phase 3 = #4593 (new closing audit, gated on Phases 1–2, triage packet → pilot task 6481). All three are linked as sub-issues. Full design: `files/designs/code-id-replication-admission.md` in the keep-the-four-repos-healthy goal workspace; register entry added (status: proposed).

## Intake review

Design issue from the design-architect audit at origin/main 73c0ec746, re-verified leg by leg in the issue body; companion to #806 / PR #4447 (the replication trust boundary it extends). Still live: no merged PR references this issue (filed today). Risks: the cursor/restore invariant spans several legs — a partial fix that covers only the named leg re-creates the hole the PR #4447 follow-up already closed once. Suggested approach: implement leg-by-leg with one failing test per leg before the fix, in the order the audit lists them.
